title: Deeala asked to help Pilk Dane

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: Have you thought about it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Have you thought about it?

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: I mean what's the alternative? I teach HIM how to roast people? It's very likely I piss him off so bad he throws me out on the street.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I mean what's the alternative? I teach HIM how to roast people? It's very likely I piss him off so bad he throws me out on the street.

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: Look, I'm only friends with people who can keep up with me. You're sharp and funny. You can do this!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Look, I'm only friends with people who can keep up with me. You're sharp and funny. You can do this!

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: What do you want?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What do you want?

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: Sure thing Darlin'. That seems fair.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sure thing Darlin'. That seems fair.

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: Love your confidence honey. I'm not sure I feel that way about you... But you ARE sweet. Sometimes... Let's see how you do with Pilk, then we'll talk.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Love your confidence honey. I'm not sure I feel that way about you... But you ARE sweet. Sometimes... Let's see how you do with Pilk, then we'll talk.

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: Wait, really? You're telling me you strung me along this far and now you want... what? Money? You've got to be fucking kidding me!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Wait, really? You're telling me you strung me along this far and now you want... what? Money? You've got to be fucking kidding me!

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: You've got my head spinning here. What the fuck do you want? Really?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You've got my head spinning here. What the fuck do you want? Really?

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: You really fucked this up, you know? I'll deal with my landlord myself. I.. thought I was falling for you. Deep down, I'm still such a sucker for losers.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You really fucked this up, you know? I'll deal with my landlord myself. I.. thought I was falling for you. Deep down, I'm still such a sucker for losers.

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: Lessons learned Deeala. Trust NO ONE. Well... fuck you very much. See you around! Or hopefully not...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Lessons learned Deeala. Trust NO ONE. Well... fuck you very much. See you around! Or hopefully not...

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: Damn... If you think that's for the best. I can try. I guess I'll... let you know how it goes. CORA knows how I'm gonna pull this off... Wish me luck.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Damn... If you think that's for the best. I can try. I guess I'll... let you know how it goes. CORA knows how I'm gonna pull this off... Wish me luck.

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: Damn, good for you! I wasn't sure you had it in you. Look, I can give you some advice. If you want it. I know how to beat him in a roast.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Damn, good for you! I wasn't sure you had it in you. Look, I can give you some advice. If you want it. I know how to beat him in a roast.

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: Good for you. You'll do great. Good luck!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Good for you. You'll do great. Good luck!

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: Ok, so Pilk is insecure. Fantastically, tragically insecure. So put him on his back foot. Don't spend too much time on defense.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ok, so Pilk is insecure. Fantastically, tragically insecure. So put him on his back foot. Don't spend too much time on defense.

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: His defining trait is fragility. Remember this. He really DOES think he's funny. He thinks he's the only one brave enough to say what he thinks out loud.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: His defining trait is fragility. Remember this. He really DOES think he's funny. He thinks he's the only one brave enough to say what he thinks out loud.

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: Yes! Exactly. He somehow thinks he's an everyman, and at the same time, a comic genius! To beat him, you have to show him that he's neither.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes! Exactly. He somehow thinks he's an everyman, and at the same time, a comic genius! To beat him, you have to show him that he's neither.

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: And he's a creepy weirdo. Confront him with that, and he'll crumble.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And he's a creepy weirdo. Confront him with that, and he'll crumble.

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: You'll do great. Good luck!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You'll do great. Good luck!

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: And he's not funny at all. Confront him with that, and he'll crumble.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And he's not funny at all. Confront him with that, and he'll crumble.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And what do I get?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And what do I get?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'd like to help, but are you sure this is a good idea?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'd like to help, but are you sure this is a good idea?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'd like to help, but are you sure this is a good idea?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'd like to help, but are you sure this is a good idea?

nodes.speaker: Player

pronounText.TextSheVersion: He's a comedian. You think I can beat him in a roast?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: He's a comedian. You think I can beat him in a roast?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Cash. Cold hard Lims.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: A date?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A date?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No wait. I changed my mind. Forget I said that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No wait. I changed my mind. Forget I said that.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: No wait. I changed my mind. Forget I said that.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: No wait. I changed my mind. Forget I said that.

nodes.text: I'm not kidding. I want the money.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm not kidding. I want the money.

pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm not kidding. I want the money.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You'll owe me a favor.

nodes.speaker: Player

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A date?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I... Uh?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I... Uh?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Ok, I'll do it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ok, I'll do it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm still not sure. I think it's better you try to roast him.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm still not sure. I think it's better you try to roast him.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm still not sure. I think it's better you try to roast him.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm still not sure. I think it's better you try to roast him.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Good luck Deeala.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Good luck Deeala.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Got you.

nodes.text: He thinks he's relatable?
